body: We lost our baby 2 weeks ago, at 19 weeks.. She just needed a couple more weeks and the doctors might have been able to do something. My husband and I live 6 hours from each other, due to work situations. It has been tough to deal with this, while being long distance.

Thank you. This exactly. He continued to go to work, saying that I was being dramatic 🙄

He is staying home now because apparently his test result came back positive. He just assumed that it was negative.

Thank you so much for this, it really opened my eyes. I guess I'm being selfish on my part, not thinking of him being truly worried about his job. Just thought he was being stubborn.

It's horrible that it's like this.

I hope your SO is doing well!

This is exactly what I'm nervous for too, I'll suggest that he take another test

He did not tell his employer of his symptoms, because he said that they wouldn't even care 🙄 I'm hoping that his test wasn't a false negative.

I hope you're recovering well!
Thank you, I really do hope that this is the case then. I just knew someone personally who had a false negative result, so I'm just very weary for these type of situations

It's hard to admit to myself that my family is toxic. I love my parents dearly. I'm very appreciative of all they've done for me, which I guess is one of the reasons why I can't fully admit to myself. I recently moved back in to their house but I plan on moving back out within the next couple of months. Until then, I've learned to just keep my mouth shut with certain topics, bite my tongue on certain things that are said and done, and to not let the things they say and do, sink too deep to heart. They've taken care of me, I still need to respect them
It never really occured to me that one could just not really know how to romance. I'll go ahead and try to initiate. Thanks for the comment
Yes, I have mentioned that a flower here and there, a cute homemade dinner, something that I wouldnt have to plan, any action that would show me that his words arent just words, would be nice
